title: Ultra-low-input native ChIP-seq for rare cell populations
protocol: Label clean 1.5 ml sample tubes.
Add 100 μl of PBS containing 1x protease inhibitor cocktail.
Sort desired cell population directly in the 1.5 ml sample tubes.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant.
Flash freeze cell pellets by immersing sample tubes in liquid nitrogen for 0.5 minute.
Store samples at -80°C.
Label clean 1.5 ml sample tubes.
Add 10-20 μl of complete nuclear isolation buffer to each tube.
Sort desired cell population directly in complete nuclear isolation buffer.
Estimate the total volume of sample, cells and sheath buffer.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C if sheath buffer contribution is above 1/3 of the final volume.
Remove all but 10 μl of nuclear isolation buffer + sheath buffer if necessary.
Add 10 μl of complete nuclear isolation buffer.
Flash freeze samples in complete nuclear isolation buffer by immersing sample tubes in liquid nitrogen for 0.5 minute.
Store samples at -80°C.
Thaw frozen cell pellet or re-suspend cells in appropriate volume of complete nuclear isolation buffer.
Pipette samples up and down 15-20 times while swirling and place back on ice.
Prepare dilute MNase stock enzyme in MNase dilution buffer to achieve a concentration of 200 U/μl.
Prepare MNase digestion buffer just before digestion.
Place samples on rack at 21-25°C.
Add MNase master mix with MNase enzyme to each sample. Mix very well (15-20 times) with pipettor.
Leave the MNase master mix on ice when digesting multiple samples simultaneously.
Allow reaction to proceed according to conditions specified in Table 2.
Stop reaction by adding 10% of the reaction volume of 100 μM EDTA and mixing very well (20-30 times) with pipette. Place samples immediately on ice.
Add 1% Triton/1% deoxycholate solution as indicated in Table 2.
Rest samples on ice for 15 minutes.
Vortex samples at medium setting for approximately 30 seconds.
Add complete immunoprecipitation buffer to the digested chromatin. Ensure that digested chromatin takes less than 25% of the immunoprecipitation volume.
Rotate chromatin at 4°C for 1 hour.
Vortex (medium setting) for 30 seconds.
Take out an input control aliquot.
Add 10% volume of 10% SDS to the input aliquot.
Mix well after adding SDS.
Add EB to obtain a final volume of 100 μl.
Proceed to DNA extraction as described in **Section D**.
Pre-wash Protein A/G magnetic beads in complete immunoprecipitation buffer three times.
Use 5 μl or 10 μl of beads for pre-clearing the chromatin based on cell input.
Use 5-10 μl of beads for immunoprecipitation.
Prepare antibody bead complexes in 200 µL PCR strip tubes.
Rotate at 4°C for 3-8 hours.
Pre-clear chromatin by adding 5 or 10 µL of pre-washed magnetic beads per immunoprecipitation, depending on input.
Rotate the mixture for 2-6 hours at 4°C.
After incubation, place antibody-bead complexes on a magnetic rack and remove supernatant.
Place pre-cleared chromatin on a magnetic rack. Transfer the chromatin (supernatant) to the antibody-beads complexes.
Rotate overnight at 4°C.
Place PCR strip tubes on a magnetic rack.
Discard unbound chromatin.
Re-suspend the beads in complete immunoprecipitation buffer and transfer them to labeled 1.5 mL sample tubes.
Place the sample tubes on a magnetic rack. Remove supernatant.
Wash antibody-bead complexes by re-suspending beads in 200 µL low salt wash buffer.
Remove the wash buffer and repeat the washing step.
Re-suspend beads in 200 μl high salt wash buffer.
Take out the wash buffer.
Re-suspend beads in 200 μl high salt wash buffer.
Transfer beads to a clean 1.5 ml sample tube.
Close the tubes and pulse-spin the beads.
Use a gel loading pipette tip to remove the last few drops of wash buffer.
Re-suspend antibody-beads complexes in 30 µl freshly prepared ChIP elution buffer.
Elute DNA for 1-1.5 hours in a 65°C water bath, vortexing tubes regularly.
Pulse-spin the sample tubes and place on a magnetic rack.
Transfer the eluted chromatin to a clean 1.5 ml sample tube.
Wash the beads with 70 µl of EB and combine with the eluted chromatin.
Transfer eluted chromatin to a pre-spun phase lock tube.
Add 100 μl of phenol: chloroform: isoamyl alcohol 25:24:1 to each sample.
Vortex vigorously for 20-30 seconds.
Spin at 13,000g for 5 minutes at 21-25°C.
Transfer the upper phase to a new 1.5 ml tube.
Add 10 µl of 3M sodium acetate.
Add 1 µl of LPA or glycogen to the solution.
Mix well.
Add 275 µl of cold Ultrapure Ethanol kept at -20°C.
Mix very well and allow DNA to precipitate for at least 30 minutes at -20°C.
Spin down DNA at 13,000g for 30 minutes at 4 degrees.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash the pellet with 200 µl of freshly prepared 70% ethanol.
Allow the pellet to dry.
Re-suspend in 20 μl or 30 μl of buffer EB, depending on cell input size.
Re-purify DNA using Agencourt Ampure XP beads if re-suspended in a low volume.
Treat with RNAse A prior to qPCR if necessary.
Re-suspend the beads well.
Add 1.8x volume of bead slurry per sample.
Mix very well with a pipette (10-12 times).
Pulse-vortex all samples 3-4 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Place the samples on a magnetic rack for 2 minutes or until clear of beads.
Remove the liquid from the beads.
Wash the beads twice with 100 µl of freshly prepared 70% ethanol while leaving them on the magnetic rack.
Take out the ethanol and pulse-spin to remove excess.
Remove the last bit of ethanol using a gel loading tip.
Allow the beads to air dry.
Add 20 or 30 μl of buffer EB to the beads, ensuring they are well covered.
Allow beads to rehydrate at room temperature for approximately 5 minutes.
Pipette up and down 15-20 times to fully resuspend.
Place the tubes back on a magnetic rack.
Transfer the eluted DNA buffer to a new tube without transferring any magnetic beads.
Thaw ChIP samples in EB buffer.
Keep on ice until the End Repair Master Mix is prepared.
Prepare the End Repair Master Mix in a clean 1.5 ml tube.
Mix thoroughly and pulse spin the master mix.
Keep the master mix on ice while distributing to sample tubes.
Add 5 μl or 7.5 μl of End Repair Master Mix to each sample tube, depending on the number of cells per ChIP.
Mix very well using a pipettor.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Set the heating block or waterbath at 37°C.
Thaw and pulse-spin end-repaired (or digested with blunt cutter) samples in 17 or 25.5 μl buffer EB.
Vortex and pulse-spin A-tailing Master Mix and add 3 or 4.5 µl to each sample.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting/stirring.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Proceed to DNA purification using Ampure XP beads.
Prepare Adaptor Ligation Master Mix in a clean tube.
Add 13.34 or 20 μl of Adaptor Ligation Master Mix to each sample.
Mix very well.
Incubate at 21-25°C for at least 30 minutes.
Proceed to DNA purification using Ampure XP beads.
Add 0.8x volume (16 or 24 μl) of Ampure XP beads.
Prepare PCR Master Mix and keep on ice until use.
Distribute 1 μl of the appropriate indexed primers PE 2.x into a PCR plate or 8-tube strips.
Distribute 13.5 μl of PCR Master Mix into sample tubes.
Add 10.5 μl of adaptor-ligated samples to PCR tubes and mix very well (10-20 times) with pipette.
Pulse-spin the tubes or plate.

Run PCR program as follows: Hot start at 98°C for 4 minutes, followed by cycles (see Table 8): 98°C for 30 seconds, 65°C for 30 seconds, 72°C for 30 seconds; then one cycle of 72°C for 5 minutes, hold at 12°C.
Proceed to DNA purification using Ampure XP beads.
Add 0.8x volume (16 or 24 μl) of Ampure XP beads.
Elute DNA in 15 μl of EB.
Evaluate library yield and quality using an Agilent Bioanalyzer (High Sensitivity DNA detection kit).
Evaluate library yield and quality using an Agilent TapeStation (D1000 High Sensitivity screen tape).
Pool libraries to be sequenced together according to their molarity and the desired number of reads.
Run the pooled libraries on an agarose gel.
Cut out the 250-650 bp fragments from the gel and transfer to a new sample tube.
Proceed to gel extraction of DNA and elute in 15 µl of EB.

Confirm the absence of adapter dimers (~ 130 bp) in the purified library pool using an Agilent Bioanalyzer (High Sensitivity DNA detection kit) or Agilent TapeStation (D1000 High Sensitivity screen tape).
